briefing.headline: META slides 6.5% as tech sector tumbles overnight
briefing.summary: All ten mega‑cap tech names fell, pulling the Nasdaq‑linked ETFs QQQ, SPY and the broader market lower. Leveraged and thematic ETFs such as SOXL, HXL and PCT also posted double‑digit drops, while the niche SNDQ was the sole gainer, up about 9.6%. The move was broad‑based with nine decliners versus one advancer, indicating a risk‑off tone heading into the US open.
